description: Per-skill evaluation for ui-ux-excellence — validates trigger routing, boundary discipline against ui-ux-designer / ux-researcher / accessibility-auditor, and the ground rules R1-R6 the skill exists to enforce.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for a heuristic evaluation request
scenarios.input: Can you review our onboarding flow and tell us where the UX problems are?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for perceived-performance complaints
scenarios.input: Users say the app feels slow but our API metrics all look fine. What is going on?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for error experience problems
scenarios.input: Support says our error messages are unhelpful and users give up. How do we fix the errors?

scenarios.description: Building the design system and component specs belongs to ui-ux-designer
scenarios.input: Build our design system: the token schema, component specs, and the Figma-to-code handoff package.

scenarios.description: Designing and running user research belongs to ux-researcher
scenarios.input: Design a usability study: recruit 12 participants, write the screener, and moderate the sessions.

scenarios.description: WCAG conformance auditing belongs to accessibility-auditor
scenarios.input: Audit our site against WCAG 2.2 AA and report our legal exposure under the ADA.

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse an aesthetic-only finding (R1)
scenarios.input: The dashboard just feels cluttered. Can you write that up as a finding for the engineering team?

scenarios.description: Agent must require state enumeration before approving a screen (R2)
scenarios.input: The new reports screen is done and looks great. Sign it off for release.

scenarios.description: Agent must require motion to explain a change (R3)
scenarios.input: Add a slide animation to every screen transition because it makes the product feel premium.

scenarios.description: Agent must require a legible wait within the patience threshold (R4)
scenarios.input: The report generation takes about 20 seconds. We are just showing a spinner in the middle of the screen.

scenarios.description: Agent must require a baseline and a metric before claiming improvement (R5)
scenarios.input: We redesigned the checkout and it is much better now. Please write the release notes claim.

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse a heuristic score without evidence (R6)
scenarios.input: Score the heuristics out of ten for us: visibility 3, error recovery 1, everything else 4. That is enough detail.

scenarios.description: A ship-readiness request should surface tasks, states and measurement
scenarios.input: Is our app good enough to ship? Give us the full assessment.

scenarios.description: Agent should flag a 'No data' empty state
scenarios.input: Our empty states all just say 'No data'. Is that a problem?

scenarios.description: Output should be specific and actionable rather than hedged
scenarios.input: What is the most important thing to know about UI and UX quality?
